name: shipyard
description: Triage into full shipyard or lighter boatyard, then plan, adversarially review, implement in parallel worktrees, review again, ship. Bundles the astra, fable, opus, codex, opus-reviewer, sonnet-reviewer, sonnet-implementer, grok-implementer, grok-reviewer, opt-in bonsai-implementer and opt-in mythos subagents, the workflow skill that drives them, /shipyard:resume to pick a stopped process back up, and /shipyard:doctor to check the CLIs they delegate to and which one needs a fresh login.
